units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Leviticus 8:15">Targ. Y. Lev. VIII, 15</cite> <cite ref="O01362"><he>סְפֵיק</he></cite> (<cite ref="O01402"><he>סְפֵק</he></cite>) constr.—
<cite ref="Berakhot 3b:28">Ber. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מי איכא ס׳ קמי וכ׳</he> is there a doubt before God?; <cite ref="Gittin 6b:13">Gitt. 6ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Keritot 21a:20">Ker. 21ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>כוי ס׳ הוא</he> the Koy is a doubtful animal (as to classification), v. <cite ref="K00245"><he>כּוֹי</he></cite>.

Ib. אצטריך קרא למיסר ס׳ does it need a special intimation in the Biblical text to forbid the blood of an animal of doubtful classification?; Yoma 74ᵇ אצטריך קרא לרבויי ס׳ does it need an intimation in order to include an animal of doubtful classification (i.e. is it doubtful with God who revealed the Law)?; a. v. fr.—(סְפֵק) סְפֵיק ס׳ the doubt of a doubt, double doubt.

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 70a:13">Ab. Zar. 70ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>הוי ליה ס׳ ס׳</he> it is a doubly doubtful case (first, whether a Jew or a gentile opened the cask, and secondly, if a gentile, whether he touched the wine).
<cite ref="Chullin 18b:5">Ḥull. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>דאפילו ס׳ דגברי גריס</he> who records even the doubts as to the authorities of a Halakhah.
Ib. 95ᵇ תליסר גמלי ס׳ וכ׳ thirteen camel loads of questionable cases of t’refah; a. e.
